metadata.document: Submission on proposed management measures for the Hauraki Gulf/Bay of Plenty (CRA 2) and Wellington/Wairarapa (CRA 4) rock lobster fisheries

cleaned_body_text: This is a submission on proposed management measures for the Hauraki Gulf/Bay of Plenty (CRA 2) and Wellington/Wairarapa (CRA 4) rock lobster fisheries as set out in the Fisheries New Zealand (FNZ) Discussion Paper No: 2025/25. The Environmental Defence Society (EDS) is an independent not-for-profit organisation conducting interdisciplinary policy research and litigation, established in 1971 to improve environmental outcomes in Aotearoa New Zealand. FNZ is consulting on draft fisheries plans to manage CRA 2 and CRA 4 stocks at a higher level of abundance than current settings. EDS supports precautionary management measures, higher biomass targets, thresholds, and meaningful fisheries plans that align with the purpose of the Fisheries Act 1996, addressing longstanding depletion of rock lobster populations, risks of recruitment failure, and demonstrated links to widespread urchin barrens.
